recognize_zh: 左圖低倍可見嗜酸性骨小樑之間被瀰漫性腫瘤細胞填滿；右圖高倍為大型多形細胞，胞質豐富淡嗜酸性、核呈不規則或腎形、染色質空泡狀並有小核仁，符合 ALCL 浸潤骨骼／軟組織。
features: Large pleomorphic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and irregular, focally kidney-shaped nuclei
Vesicular chromatin with small but distinct nucleoli; scattered hyperchromatic bizarre nuclei
Diffuse sheet-like infiltrate surrounding eosinophilic bone trabeculae at low power
Background with small clear vacuoles and scattered small lymphocytes; no necrosis in the fields shown
describe_en: Two-panel H&E image. At low power, the tissue is diffusely replaced by a hypercellular infiltrate surrounding irregular eosinophilic bony trabeculae, without residual normal marrow elements appreciable in this field. At high power, the infiltrate consists of large pleomorphic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, irregular to kidney-shaped nuclei, vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli, admixed with occasional small lymphocytes and a finely vacuolated background. Findings are consistent with involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma in the context of the known ALK-positive case; immunohistochemistry for CD30 and ALK is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with keratin positivity, whereas ALCL cells are keratin-negative and diffusely CD30/ALK-positive.
CHL shows scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory and fibrotic background rather than sheets of large anaplastic cells.
Histiocytic sarcoma expresses CD163/CD68 and lacks CD30/ALK and hallmark cells.
Sarcoma lacks lymphoid markers and CD30/ALK positivity despite similar pleomorphism.
